# Version 3.119.3
> **Preview servicing improvements** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3 previews Linux ARM64 reliability fixes and refreshed bundled native dependencies. It also fixes an ahead-of-time compilation crash in applications that disable reflection.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux ARM64 startup fixed** — The cross-compile sysroot now includes the required fontconfig runtime library, preventing a native crash on Linux ARM64. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))
- **AOT applications no longer crash without reflection** — Applications compiled with IlcDisableReflection enabled can load SkiaSharp safely. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — The preview updates libpng, libwebp, brotli, and the Skia submodule. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3474](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3474))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
